citations.quote: Llama 4 was developed following the best practices outlined in our [Developer Use Guide: AI Protections]([https://ai.meta.com/static-resource/developer-use-guide-ai-protections](https://www.llama.com/static-resource/developer-use-guide/).

We provide the community with system level [protections](https://llama.meta.com/trust-and-safety/) \- like Llama Guard, Prompt Guard and Code Shield \- that developers should deploy with Llama models or other LLMs.
Large language models, including Llama 4, are not designed to be deployed in isolation but instead should be deployed as part of an overall AI system with additional guardrails as required.
